constants:
export GO_DOWNLOAD_URL=https://go.dev/dl/go1.26.3.linux-amd64.tar.gz
export GOPATH=/home/circleci/go
export GOROOT=/usr/local/go
export PATH=$PATH:$GOROOT/bin:$GOPATH/bin
sudo apt update --fix-missing
sudo apt install --no-install-recommends -y gcc
wget "$GO_DOWNLOAD_URL" -O golang.tar.gz
echo "${GO_SHA256SUM}  golang.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -zxvf golang.tar.gz -C /tmp
sudo rm -rf ${GOROOT}
sudo mv /tmp/go ${GOROOT}

properties.explanation: AI agent input is trusted or isolated from tools and network
artifact integrity is preserved across producers and consumers
every privileged effect is dominated by an authorization gate
cache integrity is preserved across producers and consumers
the lowered graph is well-formed, phase-valid, and acyclic
credentials do not persist into reusable runner state
granted capabilities are required by a reachable effect
untrusted values do not cross an unquoted command boundary
secret values do not reach network, output, or logging effects
workflow execution cannot rewrite trusted CI definitions
untrusted checkout selection cannot race a privileged consumer
